name: Lordship
overview: The biblical teaching on Lordship emphasizes a genuine relationship with Christ marked by obedience and seeking His kingdom above all else. Jesus warns that merely calling Him 'Lord' is insufficient without doing the will of the Father (Matthew 7:21; Luke 6:46). True love for Christ is demonstrated by keeping His commandments, which results in a deep fellowship with the Father and the Son (John 14:21). Believers are justified by faith and enjoy peace through Jesus as Lord (Romans 5:1), delighting in Him and receiving the desires of their hearts as they prioritize His righteousness (Psalms 37:4; Matthew 6:33).
